LanguageData.APM_MechbandAntenna_Dominus.label: Mechband Node
LanguageData.APM_MechbandAntenna_Dominus.description: A mech-band signaling device more powerful than the mechband array. When activated, it puts out an apex level mech signal pulse, which will attract a mechanoid commander to attack with its escorts. If you defeat it, you can collect special technology from its corpse. The signal pulse burns out the dish, so this building can only be used once.
